remarks: Discover ease of living in this beautifully renovated top-floor unit, perfectly situated on a serene cul-de-sac street. Just a short walk to dining, shopping, and downtown, this home offers unparalleled convenience in a highly sought-after mid-city location. Enjoy a brand-new kitchen, bath, and flooring that elevate the unit's modern appeal. The gourmet kitchen is equipped with beautiful butcher block countertops, high-end appliances, and a window for natural light. Heat, hot water and cooking gas are included in the rent! The spacious open floor plan is ideal for entertaining, seamlessly connecting living spaces.  Benefit from an assigned parking space, a lobby-level laundry room, bike and stroller storage, and a dedicated storage cage. One pet is allowed, making it a perfect home for your furry friend. Located just minutes away from I-95 and Metro North Railroad, this unit ensures easy commuting. This is the home you've been waiting for! Don't miss out on this exceptional rental opportunity. Photos are from the previous tenant. 2 year lease available.
